title: Gentleman thugs: Benny Carter, Leroy Brown and the subway razor
summary: Refined men like Benny Carter and Leroy Brown can be the worst thugs; Butler tells of a man on the El who cut two sailors' throats after being beaten.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Well now, when you were going up on a show, the guys were very aware of -- well, for instance, a

lot of the guys I talked to, whether for this program or not, it remains very clear to me that even, for instance, they said some of the people who had the fronts of being the most refined, like for instance, Benny Carter --

Oh, my goodness, man. He was worse than the rest of them because he was refined. See, a gentleman thug is worse than -- a conscious thug; he's refined. See, he's refined but he knows how to do that act better than the other one does because he knows what to do to you and where to hit you at. That isn't an element, but he knows what to do to you. Boom! (Inaudible) and you're knocked out. (Inaudible).

See, one of the greatest thugs you ever had (inaudible) Rudolph Chapman, Leroy Brown. See, Leroy Brown was in everything but fingernails -- Brown had his manicured, talking very soft and that time---- everything. He was that. At. But he knew that he had to do this. Because, for example, I remember one time in New York, you'd get on the subway and two or three people wanted to beat you up sometimes./ So I saw one incident where some sailors come off a ship and there was a fellow, he was sitting on---when the 8th Avenue train was the El. And we were sitting there and they snatch him up, slap him a little bit. And when the train stopped, he ran off the train like he was crazy. But when the train stopped again, he reached through there with his razor and cut two of them's throat. And all them people come and the train had gone. And he was gone.
So see, with that, action like that, that sailor who
was left unscarred, he would never grab no other fellow like that and beat him up. So that's what was happening.
